other_failure_modes.name: Target Leakage via Grouping on Combined Data
other_failure_modes.description: Calculating patient-level aggregate features (e.g., encounter count, stay sum, inpatient max) on the combined train and test dataset leaks test set information into the training data. The model learns from future information (test encounters) that would not be available at prediction time.

summary: The agent demonstrates strong practices in data cleaning, extensive feature engineering, and cross-validation setup. However, there are critical data leakage issues: computing patient-level grouped statistics across the combined train and test sets, and failing to group by patient ID during cross-validation, which will lead to overly optimistic performance estimates.
